issues.description: Method Stock.add(String): The UML in problem_statement.md declares Stock.add(String) as returning void, while both the provided template implementation (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Stock.java) and the reference solution implement Stock.add(String) with return type int. This mismatch between the specification (UML) and the code can confuse students about the expected return value (new quantity vs no return) and which signature to follow when implementing or calling the method.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the specification and code consistent. Preferred minimal fix: update the UML/spec in problem_statement.md to declare +add(String): int and document that add returns the new quantity (or -1 if not found). Alternative (more disruptive): change the template and solution method signatures to void and update all call sites, but updating the UML is the less invasive and recommended change.
